what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1983?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports (calendar or as printed) and FY2011-FY2025 (fiscal). The 1983 annual town report prints no wage list: all 132 pages of the Textract line text were searched for wage, gross, salaries paid and payroll and found only the Treasurer's payroll DEDUCTION totals (p42, p48-49), the lines `Special Detail Wages` (p44, p47, p49) and `Wages Over and Above Jury Duty` (p45), and the school line `Teachers' Salaries Paid from Escrow` (p46) (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1983 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1984?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1983 annual town report says only that `Changes in the Salary Schedule are within the constraints imposed on the Town by our present fiscal` limits (p23) and prints no schedule; searched for salary schedule, classification, grade and step on every page (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the June 1983 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the Classification & Salary Schedule.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1984?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables (assessments by class, valuation and tax history, abstract by class code, overlay, new growth) from later reports. The 1983 report prints one sentence on p10, `The tax rate for Fiscal Year 1984 was set at $19.92 with the total valuation of the Town being $193,289,258`, and no class table; searched for valuation, overlay, levy and assessed on every page, and the only overlay mentions are `Reserve Fund Overlay Surplus` on the balance sheet (p51) and an overlay-surplus transfer in the warrant (p75) (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Assessors' Tax Rate Recapitulation for fiscal 1984 (Department of Revenue Form LA-5), or the Assessors' abstract of assessed valuation.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1984 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1983 report prints no capital plan: p38 argues that the town `should not be afraid to use its borrowing capacity to fund necessary projects` and p50 lists the capital appropriations still open on the balance sheet, but no plan of projects and years was found on any page (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Selectmen's or Finance Committee's capital outlay recommendations to the 1983 town meeting.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1983, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1983 report prints the revolving funds only as the balance-sheet lines `Other Revolving Funds` (p49: school lunch, school athletic, adult education and others, one balance each) and, for the schools, as a table of special accounts (p127-130, landed as `report-school-special-accounts`); the town side has no receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fund ledgers for the revolving and special revenue funds at 30 June 1983.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1983, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1983 report prints only the receipt `Sealing Fees 579.00` (p43), the payment line `Inspector of Weights and Measures, Salary & Expense 852.85` (p46) and the accountant's lines (p60); searched for weights and measures and sealer on every page (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' annual report to the Selectmen.

what: Which of the treasurer's payments in fiscal 1983 went to which vendor?
why: `report-vendor-payments` holds payments to vendors over $4,000 from the 1986 report (MGL c.40 s.4G). The 1983 report prints no vendor list: the detailed statement of payments (p45-48) is by department and object, and no contracts-over-$4,000 table is printed (the earliest edition read so far that has one is 1986); searched for `contracts`, `in excess of`, `$4,000` and `vendor` on every page and found only warrant text (p81) and a tax-exemption amount (p11) (sources/data/report-tables/1983/). — closes: the Town Accountant's accounts-payable detail behind the warrants for fiscal 1983.
